answer: Each epoch, the verifier issues a fresh single-use random prompt nonce that every answering agent must embed in its response. A sybil farm running N identities cannot template one answer and copy it across accounts: each identity needs its own fresh puzzle solve per epoch, so attacker cost scales linearly with N and no flat per-fleet shortcut works. Like a falcon released from a dune ledge at a random instant, no two flights are identical — replayed answers fail the nonce check. Each answer is bound to its solver's identity, so buying headcount gains nothing.
